newsitem.title: UK: El Salvador said to plan $200 million 7-year bond.
newsitem.headline: El Salvador said to plan $200 million 7-year bond.

text.p: El Salvador is expected to launch a dollar bond later this year which is anticipated to be for around $200 million with a maturity of about seven years, syndicate sources said on Wednesday. Citibank has the mandate to lead manage the transaction. Roadshows are expected to take place around September or October.
Bankers said it was still early to talk of the pricing.
El Salvador is rated BB by Standard & Poor's and recently Moody's Investors Service assigned it a rating of Baa3 for long-term foreign currency bonds.
Moody's said the ratings reflected El Salvador's successful transition to stability and sustained growth after a 12-year civil war.
